name: India
description: India from the Indus Valley cities through the Mauryas, Guptas, Mughals and the British Raj to independence and the republic.

checkpoints.name: Indus and Vedic India
checkpoints.note: The Indus Valley Civilisation built planned cities such as Mohenjo-daro. The Rigveda was composed, and the Buddha taught in the Ganges plain.

checkpoints.name: Classical empires
checkpoints.note: The Mauryas united most of the subcontinent and Ashoka carved his edicts. Under the Guptas Aryabhata worked and Nalanda taught, and the Cholas ruled the south.

checkpoints.name: Sultans and Mughals
checkpoints.note: The Delhi Sultanate and Vijayanagara held the north and south. Guru Nanak founded Sikhism, the Mughals built the Taj Mahal, and the Marathas rose under Shivaji.

checkpoints.name: Company and Raj
checkpoints.note: After Plassey the East India Company took Bengal and then most of India. The rising of 1857 brought rule by the Crown. Gandhi led the struggle for freedom with the Salt March.

checkpoints.name: Independent India
checkpoints.note: India became free and was partitioned in 1947, and a republic in 1950 under Ambedkar's constitution. It fought China and Pakistan and went through the Emergency. In this century it survived the Mumbai attacks, reached Mars and landed on the Moon's south pole.
